modern: You have endured endless troubles through not being content with your ruling faculty when it does the things which it is made by nature to do. But enough of this.
original: Thou hast endured infinite troubles through not being contented with thy ruling faculty when it does the things which it is constituted by nature to do. But enough [of this].
